steps.notice: January: our new insurer caps pallets at 900 kg including the load (was 1,000 kg).
February: after a near-miss the indoor forklift speed limit is now 8 km/h (was 10 km/h).

unknown_ids: ops.ch02.s3 Shift Leadership and Dock Control
ops.ch06.s2 Order Picking in Zone C
ops.ch07.s1 Packing, Labelling and Wrapping in Zone D

steps.notice: March: a new pharma client requires the cold zone to stay at or below +6 °C (was +8 °C).

unknown_ids: ops.ch04.s3 System Booking and Release to Put-Away

steps.notice: April: shift supervisors may now approve damaged-goods write-offs up to 750 EUR; above that the warehouse manager approves (was 500 EUR).

May: fleet modernisation. We replaced the whole forklift fleet and the van, and our haulier moved to new trailers: 9 counterbalance forklifts rated 3.0 t (were 6 rated 2.5 t), 5 reach trucks rated 2.0 t (were 4 rated 1.6 t), 11 electric pallet jacks (were 8), a new van with a 1,800 kg payload (was 1,200 kg) and trailers with a 26,000 kg payload (was 24,000 kg).
June: with the new loading crew each outbound door handles 4 trailer loads per shift (was 3).
July: the yard was resurfaced and the outdoor forklift speed limit is now 12 km/h (was 15 km/h).

unknown_ids: hs.ch01.s1 1.1 Speed Limits and Transport Routes
hs.ch01.s3 1.3 Forklift Authorisation and Daily Checks
hs.ch03.s2 3.2 Hazmat Cage and Spill Response (Zone F)

steps.notice: August: the fire inspection lowered the hazmat cage limit to 3,000 kg (was 4,000 kg).
September: block-stacked pallets may now be at most 3.5 m high (was 4.0 m).

unknown_ids: hs.ch03.s2 3.2 Hazmat Cage and Spill Response (Zone F)
hs.ch03.s3 3.3 Racking and Free Stacking Limits

steps.notice: October: the insurer tightened the pallet cap again, to 800 kg including the load (was 900 kg).
November: a fifth outbound dock door is in service (was 4).

unknown_ids: ops.ch02.s3 Shift Leadership and Dock Control
ops.ch07.s1 Packing, Labelling and Wrapping in Zone D
ops.ch07.s3 Vehicle Loads and Outbound Capacity

steps.notice: December: after the racking upgrade each rack bay may carry up to 3,000 kg (was 2,700 kg).
